Growth is improving, with a material currency contribution
Q2 revenue increased 12.5% in rupees, versus 6.8% in constant currency and 3.6% in US dollars. Nominal growth
therefore overstates the underlying demand acceleration. Our FY27 EQe revenue forecast requires INR 1335 crore in
H2,4.8% above H1; this is an analyst assumption, not management guidance. [S2,S3,EQ]
Business units: actual operating revenue, INR crore
AI is a growing revenue stream, still small in absolute terms
GBS generated INR 35.09 crore,5.4% of quarterly revenue. Its strong growth is encouraging but PDES still represents
76.7% and grew 6.5%. Scaling AI revenue must offset any loss of billable work from AI productivity. The model does
not capitalise unquantified cross-selling synergies or treat announced wins as booked revenue. [S2,S3]
Utilisation supports margins; customer concentration remains
Utilisation rose to 81.8% from 80.9%; TTM attrition fell to 14.3% from 15.4%. Headcount fell to 6466 from 6532. The
presentation reports 311 active clients and 95.1% repeat business. Top 5,top 10 andtop 20 clients contributed
28.7%,42.4% and 58.7% of revenue. These support visibility but also create exposure to client-budget decisions. [S3 pp

collections and a successful integration could support a higher earnings multiple. Our cautious stance would weaken if

What is agreed, and what remains conditional
The 31 Aug 2026 agreement proposes absorption of Happiest Minds into ITC Infotech. Public holders receive 25 ITC
Infotech shares for 81 existing shares if the scheme becomes effective. Separately, ITC Infotech proposes buying 22.1%
from selling promoters in two tranches for about INR 1330 crore (roughly INR 395 average). This secondary-sale
money goes to selling holders, not to the operating company or every public shareholder. [S5-S7]
The transaction presentation shows ITC Limited at approximately 73.4%, former Happiest Minds promoters 7.6% and
other public holders 19.0% after the merger. ITC Infotech-held Happiest Minds shares are cancelled. It would be
incorrect to assign 26.6% of combined equity to all currently issued Happiest Minds shares without adjusting for the
promoter sell-down, cancellation and rights issue. [S5 pp 14-15]
Strategic logic is plausible, synergy value is unproven
FY26 pro forma combined revenue is INR 7033 crore, comprising ITC Infotech 4718 and Happiest Minds 2315. The
presentation shows approximately 18.1% combined adjusted EBITDA margin excluding other income and
non-recurring items. It targets USD1 billion annual revenue by FY28. These are management pro forma
measures/aspirations, not audited combined earnings or an Equinox synergy forecast. [S5 pp 3,7,10]
Approval milestones: company timetable, not confirmed outcomes
The registered-office approval is distinct from shareholder approval of the merger scheme. Timeline data comes from the 2
Nov issuer deck; a completed merger is not assumed. Watch for actual approval filings, updated combined financials, treatment
of fractions and trading arrangements. [S3 p 24]
Management timetables are indicative and subject to approvals. This report does not opine on scheme fairness or legal entitlements.

H1 operating cash flow declined 33.5% versus INR 123.23 crore a year earlier. Cash generated before tax fell to INR
99.94 crore, compared with operating profit before working capital of INR 232.40 crore: working capital absorbed INR
132.46 crore. Trade receivables absorbed INR 35.52 crore and other financial assets INR 72.78 crore. PAT growth
therefore has not yet translated into equivalent cash generation. [S2 p 6]
Bank balances are not automatically surplus cash
At 30 Sep 2026, borrowings were INR 1480.82 crore and lease liabilities 184.96 crore. Cash equivalents were 134.20
crore, current investments 519.71 crore and other bank balances 998.82 crore. Deposits, guarantees and other financial
assets need restriction and operating-purpose checks before netting against debt. Goodwill of 778.88 crore was 43.5%
of equity 1789.12 crore. No EV multiple is computed from an unreconciled gross cash figure. [S2 p 4]
Statutory and adjusted measures are not interchangeable
Q2 reported PAT/EPS were INR 62.19 crore /4.12 diluted, versus management-adjusted PAT/EPS79.11 crore /5.25.
The deck describes adding back amortisation and exceptional items; the reported amount includes INR 3.98 crore
merger costs. Its headline EBITDA includes other income and uses total-income margins. Our operating EBITDA is
INR 121.48 crore (18.82% of operating revenue), not the deck headline 142.04 crore (21.3% of total income). [S2,S3]
The residual cash bridge is a cash-flow lens after financing-classified interest and lease payments; it is neither FCFF nor a forecast of
